name: Color Squad teen mural program
what_you_do: Join a group of teen artists who plan and paint big murals around Austin. Each year the group picks a topic in the town to work on. Past murals were made with Cap Metro and other groups.
who_can_apply: Teen artists. The page does not give ages, grades or other rules.
pay_detail: Pay or cost is not stated on the page.
deadline_text: No dates on the page. Email to ask when the next group starts.
how_to_apply: Email lindsay@creativeaction.org to ask how to join.
notes: Ask about ages, schedule, pay and cost before you plan on it. Creative Action also lists the Changing Lives Youth Theatre Ensemble for teens.
